name: CUbIQ Technologies
description: CUbIQ Technologies develops Continuous Variable QKD (CV-QKD) transceivers packaged in standard QSFP-28 pluggable modules, enabling quantum-secure key distribution at a fraction of the cost and power of conventional rack-based QKD systems. The company demonstrated a proof-of-concept at ECOC 2025 in collaboration with Coherent and Liberty Global. CUbIQ was spun out of Eindhoven University of Technology.
funding: EIC Transition grant (~€2.5M); NWO Take-off Grant 2 (Dutch Research Council)

products.description: Continuous Variable QKD transceiver in standard QSFP-28 pluggable form factor for quantum-secure key distribution
